# Chart fixtures

DrawingML chart parts the chart reader's tests read, each taken unmodified from a redistributable file under the license named. No GPL file and no upload to a project's bug tracker.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `python-pptx-cht-chart-type-chart7.xml` | `ppt/charts/chart7.xml` of https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx/blob/master/features/steps/test_files/cht-chart-type.pptx (slide 2, top left): a clustered bar chart of three series over four categories, its category axis minMax with tick labels none. Its one CRLF is stored as LF, as `.gitattributes` stores text | MIT, Copyright (c) 2013 Steve Canny, https://github.com/scanny |
